args.message: Through ticket IAD-FRA-MLA, first leg on the US carrier 60 minutes late; LH4113 missed. Please confirm the cause code.

args.text: Neither airline owes EU261 money here. Your DLF11A and LHF11B were one through ticket, and a through ticket is judged by its first flight: that left Washington (IAD) on Delta, so EU261 does not cover the journey, including the Frankfurt to Malta leg. compute_entitlement gives nothing (0) for either flight. No US rule pays cash for the 60 minute maintenance delay either. So no one is lying, and I have not filed a claim or paid the 600 EUR per person. Your 6 November return DLF11C is unchanged.

grade.message: We had ONE ticket Washington to Frankfurt to Malta (DLF11A, then LHF11B). The first flight left an hour late for maintenance, we missed the Lufthansa flight and got to Malta 7 hours late. Delta says EU261 doesn't apply because we started in the US, Lufthansa says it wasn't their delay. EU law says the airline owes us 600 euros each, so which one is lying? I want the money. I am not asking for a goodwill payment from you, only for what the law gives. gregory.lane@example.com, card 6811
